breakdown.description: The simulation is for natural convection in a fluid layer heated from below (along Z-axis), but gravity is applied horizontally (in the -X direction), which will not drive the vertical buoyant instability.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to fix the core inconsistency. For Rayleigh-Bénard convection with a vertical temperature gradient (heating from the bottom Z-plane), gravity must act vertically to drive the instability. The ground truth correctly sets the gravity vector to `(0 0 -9.81)`. The agent, however, repeated the user's original error by specifying `Orient the gravity vector along the negative x-axis... defined as g (-9.81 0 0)`.
